Load and filter data (Tolerant vs Damaged - 170 ppb)

# Cargar directamente usando la columna 'gene_id' como rownames
alldata <- as.matrix(read.delim("outputs_Rstudio_dia3//allreadsgenes.txt", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))

# Verificar dimensiones y primeras filas
dim(alldata)
## [1] 46178     6
head(alldata)
##               DC_1 DC_3 DC_4 TC_1 TC_3 TC_4
## AB_000001_T.1   97  143  137   31   49   41
## AB_000002_T.1  946  794  830  764 1031  758
## AB_000003_T.1 3856 5217 1832 1944 3102 2554
## AB_000004_T.1  449  449  402  246  283  303
## AB_000005_T.1    0    0    0    0    3    0
## AB_000006_T.1  736  935  904  612  735  572
# Definir metadatos respetando el orden exacto de las columnas de alldata (DC_1..TC_4)
sample_cols <- colnames(alldata)
targets <- data.frame(
  treatment = factor(c("DC", "DC", "DC", "TC", "TC", "TC"), levels = c("DC", "TC")),
  label = sample_cols,
  row.names = sample_cols
)

# Filtrado estadístico robusto (elimina transcritos con conteos muy bajos)
d_raw <- DGEList(counts = alldata, group = targets$treatment)
keep <- filterByExpr(d_raw, group = targets$treatment)
table(keep)
## keep
## FALSE  TRUE 
## 16326 29852
filtconteos <- alldata[keep, ]

Filter & Export Significant DEGs (FDR < 0.05)

dir.create("outputs_Rstudio_dia3//DGE", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. Filtrar y exportar edgeR (FDR < 0.05)
sig_edgeR <- subset(top_edgeR, FDR < 0.05)
sig_edgeR <- cbind(gene_id = rownames(sig_edgeR), sig_edgeR)
write.table(sig_edgeR, "outputs_Rstudio_dia3//DGE/EdgeR_TCvsDC_170ppb_FDR_0.05.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# 2. Filtrar y exportar DESeq2 (padj < 0.05)
sig_DESeq2 <- subset(res_DESeq2_df, !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05)
sig_DESeq2 <- cbind(gene_id = rownames(sig_DESeq2), sig_DESeq2)
write.table(sig_DESeq2, "outputs_Rstudio_dia3//DGE/DESeq2_TCvsDC_170ppb_FDR_0.05.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# 3. Exportar tablas completas (sin filtrar) con 'gene_id' como primera columna
top_edgeR_out <- cbind(gene_id = rownames(top_edgeR), top_edgeR)
write.table(top_edgeR_out, "outputs_Rstudio_dia3//DGE/EdgeR_TCvsDC_170ppb_ALL.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

res_DESeq2_out <- cbind(gene_id = rownames(res_DESeq2_df), res_DESeq2_df)
write.table(res_DESeq2_out, "outputs_Rstudio_dia3//DGE/DESeq2_TCvsDC_170ppb_ALL.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

Consensus DEGs (edgeR vs DESeq2)

genes_edgeR <- sig_edgeR$gene_id
genes_DESeq2 <- sig_DESeq2$gene_id
genes_comunes <- intersect(genes_edgeR, genes_DESeq2)

cat("Transcritos DE en edgeR (FDR < 0.05):", length(genes_edgeR), "\n")
## Transcritos DE en edgeR (FDR < 0.05): 43
cat("Transcritos DE en DESeq2 (padj < 0.05):", length(genes_DESeq2), "\n")
## Transcritos DE en DESeq2 (padj < 0.05): 93
cat("Transcritos DE consensuados (en ambos):", length(genes_comunes), "\n")
## Transcritos DE consensuados (en ambos): 38
head(genes_comunes)
